title: FlexTSF: A Flexible Forecasting Model for Time Series with Variable Regularities
abstract: arXiv:2410.23160v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generalizing across time series with irregular temporal structures poses a persistent challenge for universal time series forecasting models. Existing approaches often assume regular sampling or depend heavily on imputation, which limits their applicability in real-world scenarios where irregularities are prevalent due to diverse sensing devices and recording practices. To address this gap, we propose FlexTSF, a flexible and domain-adaptive forecasting model specifically designed for time series with variable temporal regularities. At its foundation lies the IVP Patcher, a continuous-time patching module leveraging Initial Value Problems (IVPs) to inherently handle uneven sampling intervals, variable sequence lengths, and missing values. translated_title: FlexTSF：一种面向具有可变规律性的时间序列的灵活预测模型
translated_abstract: 对于通用时间序列预测模型而言，在具有不规则时间结构的时间序列上进行泛化是一个长期的挑战。现有方法通常假设采样是规律的，或严重依赖插补技术，这限制了它们在现实场景中的适用性——由于多样化的传感设备和记录方式，不规则性在实际场景中普遍存在。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 FlexTSF，这是一种灵活且领域自适应的预测模型，专为具有可变时间规律性的时间序列而设计。其基础是 IVP Patcher，这是一个利用初值问题（IVPs）的连续时间分块模块，能够从本质上处理不均匀的采样间隔、可变的序列长度以及缺失值。FlexTSF 构建于仅解码器的 Transformer 架构之上，通过专门的因果自注意力机制整合了归一化的时间戳输入和特定领域的统计描述符（注：原文摘要到此被截断）。
tldr: FlexTSF 提出了一种灵活的领域自适应时间序列预测模型，其核心的 IVP Patcher 连续时间分块模块基于初值问题，能够原生处理不均匀采样间隔、可变序列长度和缺失值，从而有效应对不规则时间序列的通用预测挑战。
en_tdlr: FlexTSF is a flexible, domain-adaptive forecasting model for time series with variable temporal regularities, whose core IVP Patcher—a continuous-time patching module based on Initial Value Problems—inherently handles uneven sampling intervals, variable sequence lengths, and missing values.
